name: Sources
description: Represents a collection of Source objects.
remarks: For more information, see Working with Bibliographies.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Returns the number of items in the Sources collection. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Word application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the add-in was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the parent object of the specified Sources object.

methods.name: Item
methods.description: Returns a Source object that represents the specified item in the collection.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: Specifies the ordinal position of the object within the collection.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Add a new source to the sources listed in the Source Manager dialog box.

parameters.name: Data
parameters.description: An XML string that represents the field values for the new source.
